item.title: Fukui Prefectural Natural History Museum: Local Ecology and Natural Science — Guide
item.description: The Fukui Prefectural Natural History Museum offers a broader look at the prefecture’s natural science beyond dinosaurs, covering local ecology, geology and wildlife through hands-on exhibits and displays that give visitors a fuller picture of Fukui’s natural environment across different eras. Considerably smaller and less visited than the famous Dinosaur Museum, it makes a good complementary stop for visitors with a genuine interest in natural history rather than dinosaurs alone, or a manageable outing for families with younger children.
